description_sq:
Shitet objekt multi-funksional ne kryqezimin e rruges “Bardhyl”, shume prane qendes spitalore “Nene Tereza”. 
Ndertesa eshte e projektuar per cdo lloj biznesi fale pozicionin strategjik buze rruges kryesore. 
Ambienti ka siperfaqje 250 m2 dhe eshte i organizuar ne 2 kate, kati o dhe -1. 
Ka fasade te konsiderueshme dhe verande te shfrytezueshme 150m2. 
Ky ambient eshte i restauruar se fundmi.
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni!
description_en: Multi-functional building for sale at the intersection of "Bardhyl" street, very close to "Mother Teresa" hospital center. The building is designed for any type of business thanks to its strategic position on the main road. The environment has an area of ​​250 m2 and is organized on 2 floors, floor o and -1. It has a substantial facade and usable veranda of 150m2. This environment has been recently restored. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
